notes: Douglas County prints no local voters' pamphlet for the general; candidate statements and measure texts are in VoteWA's online voters' guide (genericvoterguide.aspx?e=899&c=09).
The proposed Rimrock Meadows Fire Protection District No. 9 and its commissioner races are scoped to the county's Fire Districts layer (FireNumber '009'); DOR's 2025 fire layer has no such district.

measures.jurisdiction: Public Hospital District No. 1, Okanogan and Douglas Counties (Three Rivers Hospital)
measures.title: Bonds for Hospital Renovation and Improvement
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes up to $48,000,000 of general obligation bonds, maturing within 30 years and repaid by an excess property tax levy, to remodel, renovate, equip and improve Three Rivers Hospital in Brewster. Needs 60% yes.
measures.cost_line: Estimated $0.73 per $1,000 of assessed value (about $219 a year, or $18 a month, on a $300,000 home); up to $48,000,000 in bonds over up to 30 years.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Douglas County Public Hospital District No. 2
measures.title: Special One-Year Excess Maintenance and Operations Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a one-year excess levy for the Waterville-area hospital district, which runs its own ambulance service and a clinic contracted with Wenatchee Valley Medical Center.
measures.cost_line: $80,000, approximately $0.36 per $1,000 of assessed value, collected in 2027.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Bonds to Rebuild and Modernize Deteriorating Schools and Improve Safety
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes $125,000,000 of general obligation bonds, repaid by excess property taxes over up to 20 years, to rebuild the oldest parts of Cascade, Kenroy and Lee elementary schools (replacing 15 portables with permanent classrooms) and fund districtwide roofing, HVAC, lighting, parking, pickup and athletic-facility upgrades; the district expects about $25 million in state construction assistance. Needs 60% yes.
measures.cost_line: $125,000,000 in bonds over up to 20 years; the district estimates about $0.79 per $1,000 of assessed value (about $237 a year on a $300,000 home).

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Proposed Rimrock Meadows Fire Protection District No. 9
measures.title: Formation of Rimrock Meadows Fire Protection District No. 9
measures.what_it_does: Forms a fire protection district (RCW 52.02) for the Rimrock Meadows area north of Ephrata, which has no fire district today, governed by three elected commissioners and financed by a property tax levy. The commissioner races on the same ballot fill its first board if it forms.
measures.cost_line: No levy is set by this vote; once formed, the district's board may levy regular property taxes for fire protection (up to $0.50 per $1,000 under RCW 52.16.130, with further $0.50 levies under RCW 52.16.140 and .160 subject to the statutory limits).

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Special One-Year Excess Maintenance and Operations Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes the cemetery district's one-year excess levy for maintenance, operations and irrigation of its seven cemeteries and one mausoleum around Waterville.
measures.cost_line: $50,000, approximately $0.22 per $1,000 of assessed value, collected in 2027.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.
